notes.title: FIRST TIME: 60% DISCOUNT
notes.content:
For the first time, Claws & Feathers 3 is 60% off:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/715240/Claws__Feathers_3/
Help brave birds find a new home and stay out of the clutches of cunning cats! A variety of puzzles awaits you with a fascinating story, pleasant graphics, and relaxing music. Time to go into space!

notes.title: TETRAGON RECEIVED RELEASE DATE
notes.content:
Friends, fans of puzzles, secrets and mysterious worlds!

We are pleased to announce that the dizzying anti-gravity adventure Tetragon  has received a release date - 12 August!

An amazing story about the adventures of a simple lumberjack Lucius, traveling across picturesque square worlds in search of his son, who suddenly disappeared under mysterious circumstances, is about to become available to everyone.

[previewyoutube=42fcJfiuFBg;full][/previewyoutube]

Do not forget to add the game to your wishlist and please all your friends with this wonderful news:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1545850/Tetragon/
You can also try out the game right now as part of a free demo!
